fact: Experimental results indicate that learning associations requires explicit awareness of the cues' role, and participants apply the mapping of the most similar trained shape, consistent with the Bayesian learning model.
source_span: The experimental results show that , although learning the associations requires explicit awareness of the cues’ role , participants apply the mapping corresponding to the trained shape that is most similar to the current one , consistent with the Bayesian learning model .
